scripts.activate-theme: wp-env run cli theme activate hello-elementor
scripts.set-site-title: wp-env run cli option set blogname test
scripts.import-files: wp-env run cli "wp --user=admin elementor library import_dir /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/elementor/tests/screenshotter/config"
scripts.full-test: npm i && npm run start && npm run activate-theme && npm run set-site-title && npm run import-files && npm run test
scripts.local-full-test: npm run cleanup && npm run full-test
